entries.12b31a89fa645439: Its basic philosophy is to 'always respond to customer requests and strive to create new value suited to the times,' and it aims to continue growing in global markets as well as in Japan and to enhance corporate value through products based on vibration measurement technology. The three-year medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended March 2026 to March 2028) sets out five main management strategies: conducting R&D through investment in people and technology; expanding global market share through active entry into overseas markets; establishing production systems at the manufacturing plants of the consolidated subsidiaries in Japan, the United States, South Korea and China; establishing a global sales expansion system for the tire uniformity/balance combined testing machine (UB machine) as a strategic product; and establishing R&D and sales expansion systems for various electric servo motor-type testing machines as future pillars of the business.

entries.44aab6b9a2bc0d87: Built on vibration measurement technology, the company manufactures and sells both balancers for measurement purposes and automatic balance correction devices that automatically correct imbalance in balancing machines. The electric servo motor-type testing machines adopt a control system developed in-house (patented); they are testing machines of a different type from conventional hydraulic types, and the product lineup exceeds 30 types. The company has developed combined machines that measure balance and uniformity tests of finished tires simultaneously in one unit, and a high-speed in-line combined testing machine (H-UB machine) that measures under actual running conditions, and has sales records both in Japan and overseas.
